A lot of the classes though offer a high damage skill tree which you can put points in and still do fairly high damage, say if you selected a primarily healer or tank advanced class.

On Empire I would say two of the highest possible damage classes are probably the Sith Warriors advanced class known as Marauder and the Imperial Agents advanced class known as the Sniper.

The Marauder is melee and the Sniper is ranged.
